newsitem.title: USA: Securfone to buy 90 pct of Material Tech.
newsitem.headline: Securfone to buy 90 pct of Material Tech.

text.p: Material Technology Inc said it will sell at least 90 percent of its stock to Securfone America.

Material Technology, which did not say how much Securfone America ould pay for its stock, characterized the transaction as a reverse merger. It will form a unit to which it will transfer all assets and liabiliaties, it said. Its officials were not immediately available to comment.
Its shareholders will retain their interest in the company's metal fatigue technologies business and own part of Securfone's cellular and calling card business, it added.
